entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Feuia foki akoe Atua akoe gani konia auau sirnaea akoe, go akoe gani komaro. Ingatamara foki akoe gani natamana poulapa, kit teulia go mujia miefa geia tmoutrara. Go kainugia foki akoe geia nekelela gani mafitlakena toturu akoe Atua.
